    • Method Detail

      • eval

        @PublishedMethod
public static IFormulaResult eval(@Nonnull
                                                    com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.commonpatterns.formulalanguage.MIFormulaExpression self)
        The formula expression can contain a simple numeric literal, a boolean literal, or a more advanced expression that handles references to autosar model elements, arithmetic functions, special functions, and special values. Therefore, the method eval(MIFormulaExpression) is used to do the evaluation and return the result as IFormulaResult.
        Parameters:
        self -
        Returns:
        IFormulaResult

      • setValue

        @PublishedMethod
public static void setValue(@Nonnull
                                              com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.commonpatterns.formulalanguage.MIFormulaExpression self,
                                              java.lang.Boolean value)
        The method setValue(MIFormulaExpression, Boolean) replaces the content of the passed MIFormulaExpression by the string representation of the provided Boolean value. Throws NullPointerException if any of the parameters is null.
        Parameters:
        self - the MIFormulaExpression whose content will be updated.
        value - the boolean value to set.
        Throws:
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if any of the parameters is null.
